[!GOOS:linux] skip 'the capability controls use Linux socket syscalls'

env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
mkdir $WORK/bin
cd main

# A dependency's harmless Once callback does not inherit a different
# first-party Once callback's network capability. Neither executable opens
# a socket without an argument; both must still retain the reachable branch.
go build -O=2 -o $WORK/bin/plain-safe$GOEXE ./cmd/safe
exec $WORK/bin/plain-safe$GOEXE
stderr '^inline-once-ok$'

logos build -gcflags=example.com/inlinecapdep/safe=-m -gcflags=example.com/inlinecaphost/cmd/safe=-m -o $WORK/bin/logos-safe$GOEXE ./cmd/safe
stderr 'safe\.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: inlining call to sync\.\(\*Once\)\.Do'
stderr 'main\.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: inlining call to sync\.\(\*Once\)\.Do'
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/logos-safe$GOEXE
stderr '^inline-once-ok$'

# A real dependency callback that opens a socket must remain denied.
go build -O=2 -o $WORK/bin/plain-callback$GOEXE ./cmd/callback
! logos build -gcflags=example.com/inlinecapdep/callback=-m -o $WORK/bin/logos-callback$GOEXE ./cmd/callback
stderr 'callback\.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: inlining call to sync\.\(\*Once\)\.Do'
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/inlinecapdep/callback'' reaches ''syscall\.Socket'''
stderr 'example\.com/inlinecapdep/callback\.openSocket\(\)'

# A dependency's own sink call remains its responsibility after its entire
# wrapper is inlined into the first-party main function.
go build -O=2 -o $WORK/bin/plain-direct$GOEXE ./cmd/direct
! logos build -gcflags=example.com/inlinecaphost/cmd/direct=-m -o $WORK/bin/logos-direct$GOEXE ./cmd/direct
stderr 'main\.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: inlining call to direct\.Open'
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/inlinecapdep/direct'' reaches ''syscall\.Socket'''
stderr 'example\.com/inlinecapdep/direct\.Open\(\)'

-- main/go.mod --
module example.com/inlinecaphost

go 1.27

require example.com/inlinecapdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/inlinecapdep => ../dep

-- main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- main/cmd/safe/main.go --
package main

import (
	"net"
	"os"
	"sync"

	"example.com/inlinecapdep/safe"
)

var firstOnce sync.Once

func main() {
	if safe.Touch() != 7 {
		panic("safe callback did not run")
	}
	firstOnce.Do(firstPartyNetwork)
	println("inline-once-ok")
}

//go:noinline
func firstPartyNetwork() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
		if err == nil {
			listener.Close()
		}
	}
}

-- main/cmd/callback/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/inlinecapdep/callback"

func main() { callback.Open() }

-- main/cmd/direct/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/inlinecapdep/direct"

func main() { direct.Open() }

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/inlinecapdep

go 1.27

-- dep/safe/safe.go --
package safe

import "sync"

var once sync.Once
var value int

//go:noinline
func Touch() int {
	once.Do(func() { value = 7 })
	return value
}

-- dep/callback/callback.go --
package callback

import (
	"sync"
	"syscall"
)

var once sync.Once

//go:noinline
func Open() { once.Do(openSocket) }

//go:noinline
func openSocket() {
	fd, err := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	if err == nil {
		syscall.Close(fd)
	}
}

-- dep/direct/direct.go --
package direct

import "syscall"

func Open() { _, _ = syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0) }
